required_source_applied.application: for the exact-rank-three stress family, ess sup on the majority one-sheet t>=0 is at most pi sqrt(2); the new work targets the t<0 two-sheet side

new_results.statement: There is an exact-rank-three family with spectrum {1,1,-1}, one fixed leverage c>1/2, all minority physical diagonals -beta/m, and physical cone-cover currency Gamma_- at least sqrt(m)*min(beta^(-1/2),sqrt(2(2-beta))/(1-beta)); nevertheless aggregate bank coarea gives a dimension-free bound.
new_results.scope: mechanism counterexample, not a QFORM counterexample

new_results.statement: For exact rank three, if one original-coordinate bank carries an entire spectral eigenline, rows c_i e1 with sum c_i^2=1, then ||p_Q||_infinity <=16 sqrt(60)|lambda1|^(-1/2)|lambda2 lambda3|^(-1/4), hence <=16 sqrt(60)/s when all three eigenvalue magnitudes are at least s.
new_results.scope: arbitrary independent cap-one rough laws; essential boundedness; exact rank three; no affine/outside-coupling extension claimed

partner_results_applied.application: on the non-coloop stress family, kappa=beta and aggregate determinant mass mu=beta, giving ||p_Q||<=8*2^(3/4)*sqrt(5)*beta^(-1/2), independent of dimension m and heavy-row leverage c
the physical-pair L^p receiver still pays (D*kappa)^(-1/4)=c^(-1/4)beta^(-1/2)sqrt(m) on the heavy/minority pair, proving that residual L^p smoothing alone cannot cure the local-pair geometry

first_unpaid_implication.statement: In an exact-rank-three indefinite survivor with no diffuse-volume exit and no complete eigenbank peel, either extract aggregate banks with uniformly nondegenerate scalar compression or directly spend the rank-two bank's embedded third curvature when every scalar compression is singular/near-isotropic.

next_step: Develop a product-preserving coarea/half-Riesz estimate for a rank-two bank coupled to a near-isotropic scalar-bank plane when neither scalar bank is a complete eigenbank; avoid physical-pair inversion before aggregate curvature is spent.
